worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.summary: Slap smelling salts across a foe's face: against a paralysed target the blow is doubled, but it also cures that paralysis. A paralysed ally is woken without taking any damage, and coarse salt leaves a woken foe staggering. Whoever is actually slapped is the one whose state counts.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.use.0: Land a doubled blow while the foe is paralysed
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.use.1: Hit a paralysed target once, hard
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.descript: The salt slap deals about %1$s physical damage; if the target actually slapped is paralysed right now the power is doubled, and a hit cures its paralysis. A friendly target takes no damage and is only woken if truly paralysed.

Reach: %1$s blocks. Hit radius: %2$s blocks. A non-ally hit is pushed back %3$s blocks. The first body (ally included) or wall stops it at the real contact, and a third body in the way is resolved by what was actually slapped, never by the original target.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.coarse.o: Coarse salt on: knockback ×1.5 and curing an enemy's paralysis leaves a short stagger that lowers movement speed by 15%; in exchange the hit is about ×0.90 and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer.
Coarse salt off: the hit is about ×1.06, waking the foe cleanly and putting all of it into damage.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks (ally or enemy, or swing at empty air); after %2$s seconds it spends %4$s PP to fire, then recovers for %3$s seconds and starts a %5$s second cooldown on commit.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.growth.0: At level %1$s the salts power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.growth.1: At level %1$s the salts power rises to %2$s and the coarse-salt stagger lengthens to %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.preferen: On: knockback ×1.5 and curing an enemy's paralysis leaves a short stagger (slowness); but the hit is ×0.90 and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer. Off: the hit is ×1.06, waking the foe cleanly.
Slap only at targets within this distance; raise it to chase paralysed targets farther away.
On: prioritize paralyzed enemies for the doubled-power hit. Off: keep the ordinary low priority without weighting paralysis.
On: a paralysed ally nearby is treated as an urgent rescue and slapped awake first. Off: only enemies are targeted, leaving allies to recover on their own.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.descript: Paralysis normally lasts about 40 seconds: the target's movement speed is halved and each move it makes has a 25% chance to fail; Electric-type targets cannot be paralysed. A hit cures the paralysis outright.
